BiblicalUsage: Potiphar is the Egyptian officer who buys Joseph as a slave, captain of the guard under Pharaoh. Joseph prospers in his house, and Potiphar sees that the Lord is with him and makes him overseer of all he has.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God was with Joseph in the slave's house, and even his master could see it.
